svg.title: Diode
svg.desc: Diode, IEEE 315-1975 §8.5.1 semiconductor diode (envelope omitted, §8.2.2 filled triangle touching the bar). Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: start (anode) (24,8), end (cathode) (24,68).
